local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return {

	Name = "bind",

	Description = "Binds a command string to a key or mouse input.",

	Group = "DefaultUtil",

	Aliases = {},

	Args = {

		{

			Type = "userInput ! bindableResource @ player",

			Name = "Input",

			Description = "The key or input type you\'d like to bind the command to."

		},

		{

			Type = "command",

			Name = "Command",

			Description = "The command you want to run on this input"

		},

		{

			Type = "string",

			Name = "Arguments",

			Description = "The arguments for the command",

			Default = ""

		}

	},

	ClientRun = function(p1, p2, p3, p4) --[[ ClientRun | Line: 27 | Upvalues: UserInputService (copy) ]]

		local v1 = p1:GetStore("CMDR_Binds")

		local v2 = p3 .. " " .. p4

		if v1[p2] then

			v1[p2]:Disconnect()

		end

		local v3 = p1:GetArgument(1).Type.Name

		if v3 == "userInput" then

			v1[p2] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(p12, p22) --[[ Line: 39 | Upvalues: p2 (copy), p1 (copy), v2 (ref) ]]

				if p22 then

					return

				end

				if p12.UserInputType ~= p2 and p12.KeyCode ~= p2 then

					return

				end

				p1:Reply(p1.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(p1.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(p1.Dispatcher, v2)))

			end)

		else

return {

	Name = "run-lines",

	Description = "Splits input by newlines and runs each line as its own command. This is used by the init-run command.",

	Group = "DefaultUtil",

	Aliases = {},

	Args = {

		{

			Type = "string",

			Name = "Script",

			Description = "The script to parse.",

			Default = ""

		}

	},

	ClientRun = function(p1, p2) --[[ ClientRun | Line: 15 ]]

		if #p2 == 0 then

			return ""

		end

		local v1 = p1.Dispatcher:Run("var", "INIT_PRINT_OUTPUT") ~= ""

		for i, v in ipairs((p2:gsub("\n+", "\n"):split("\n"))) do

			if v:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then

				local v3 = p1.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(v)

				if v1 then

					p1:Reply(v3)

				end

			end

		end

		return ""

	end

}

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

return {

	Name = "help",

	Description = "Displays a list of all commands, or inspects one command.",

	Group = "Help",

	Args = {

		{

			Type = "command",

			Name = "Command",

			Description = "The command to view information on",

			Optional = true

		}

	},

	ClientRun = function(p1, p2) --[[ ClientRun | Line: 31 ]]

		if p2 then

			local v1 = p1.Cmdr.Registry:GetCommand(p2)

			p1:Reply(("Command: %*"):format(v1.Name), Color3.fromRGB(230, 126, 34))

			if v1.Aliases and #v1.Aliases > 0 then

				p1:Reply(("Aliases: %*"):format((table.concat(v1.Aliases, ", "))), Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230))

			end

			p1:Reply(v1.Description, Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230))

			for i, v in ipairs(v1.Args) do

				p1:Reply((("#%* %*%*: %* - %*"):format(i, v.Name, if v.Optional == true then "?" else "", v.Type, v.Description)))

			end

		else

			p1:Reply("Argument Shorthands\n-------------------\n.   Me/Self\n*   All/Everyone\n**  Others\n?   Random\n?N  List of N random values\n")

			p1:Reply("Tips\n----\n\226\128\162 Utilize the Tab key to automatically complete commands\n\226\128\162 Easily select and copy command output\n")

			local v5 = p1.Cmdr.Registry:GetCommands()

			table.sort(v5, function(p1, p2) --[[ Line: 49 ]]

				if not (p1.Group and p2.Group) then

					return p1.Group

				end

				return p1.Group < p2.Group

			end)

			local v6 = nil

			for i, v in ipairs(v5) do

				local v7

				v.Group = v.Group or "No Group"

				if v6 ~= v.Group then

					p1:Reply((("\n%*\n%*"):format(v.Group, (string.rep("-", #v.Group)))))

					v6 = v.Group

				end

				v7 = if v.Description then ("%* - %*"):format(v.Name, v.Description) else v.Name

				p1:Reply(v7)

			end

		end

		return ""

	end

}

[ModuleScript] ReplicatedStorage.CmdrClient.Commands.debug_loadAllPanels
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
-- https://lua.expert/

return {

	Name = "debug_loadAllPanels",

	Description = "Loads all panels for the sender",

	Group = "Debug",

	Aliases = {},

	Args = {},

	ClientRun = function(p1) --[[ ClientRun | Line: 7 ]]

		local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

		local LazyPanels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Client.UI.LazyPanels)

		local PanelController = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Client.UI.PanelController)

		for v1, v2 in LazyPanels.Panels do

			for v3, v4 in v2 do

				if PanelController.LoadLazy(v1, v3, false) then

					p1:Reply((("Loaded panel %* in context %*"):format(v3, v1)))

				end

			end

		end

		return "Loaded all panels"

	end

}

[ModuleScript] ReplicatedStorage.CmdrClient.Commands.client_crashClient
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
-- https://lua.expert/

return {

	Name = "client_crashClient",

	Description = "Force a crash on the client",

	Group = "Client",

	Aliases = {},

	Args = {

		{

			Type = "number",

			Name = "KB",

			Description = "The amount of memory to leak to in KB"

		}

	},

	ClientRun = function(p1, p2) --[[ ClientRun | Line: 13 ]]

		local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")

		local t = {}

		local t2 = {}

		while true do

			local t3 = {}

			for i = 1, 1000000 do

				table.insert(t3, math.random())

			end

			if #t > 1000 then

				table.insert(t2, t)

			else

				table.insert(t, t3)

			end

			if p2 < gcinfo() / 1024 then

				break

			end

			local v1 = gcinfo() / 1024

			p1:Reply("Memory usage:" .. tostring(v1) .. "MB" .. "  Total" .. Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb())

			task.wait(0.1)

		end

		p1:Reply("Stopping at Memory usage:" .. tostring(gcinfo() / 1024) .. "MB")

		task.delay(999999999, function() --[[ Line: 33 | Upvalues: t (copy), t2 (copy) ]]

			print(#t, #t2)

		end)

	end

}

local v1 = workspace:WaitForChild("WorkspaceCom"):FindFirstChild("001_TrafficCones")

return {

	Name = "prop_getPropOwner",

	Description = "Gets the owner of a prop",

	Group = "Prop",

	Aliases = {},

	Args = {},

	ClientRun = function(p1) --[[ ClientRun | Line: 10 | Upvalues: v1 (copy) ]]

		local v12 = p1.Executor:GetMouse()

		if not v12.Target then

			return "No prop found"

		end

		for i, v in ipairs(v1:GetChildren()) do

			if v:IsA("Model") and v12.Target:IsDescendantOf(v) then

				return v.Name:sub(5)

			end

		end

		return "No prop found"

	end

}

	ClientRun = function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7) --[[ ClientRun | Line: 51 | Upvalues: Players (copy) ]]

		local Character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character

		if not Character then

			return "Player has no character"

		end

		if not Character:HasTag("IceSkating") then

			return "Player is not currently skating"

		end

		if p2 ~= 0 and (p2 ~= 1 and p2 ~= 2) then

			return "Spider mode must be 0, 1, or 2"

		end

		local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

		local v1 = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Client.Components.LiveOps.Christmas2025.IceSkating):FromInstance(Character)

		if not v1 then

			return "Couldn\'t find IceSkating component, did it error during construction?"

		end

		v1:UpdateConfigs(p2, p3, p4, p5 or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), if p6 then p6 * 32 else 32, p7 or Vector3.new(0, -9.81, 0))

		return "Configs changed successfully \240\159\171\161"

	end

}

[ModuleScript] ReplicatedStorage.CmdrClient.Types.Color3 ⚠️ AC[validate]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
-- https://lua.expert/

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Util)

local v1 = Util.MakeSequenceType({

	Prefixes = "# hexColor3 ! brickColor3",

	Length = 3,

	ValidateEach = function(p1, p2) --[[ ValidateEach | Line: 5 ]]

		if p1 == nil then

			return false, ("Invalid or missing number at position %d in Color3 type."):format(p2)

		end

		if p1 < 0 or p1 > 255 then

			return false, ("Number out of acceptable range 0-255 at position %d in Color3 type."):format(p2)

		end

		if p1 % 1 == 0 then

			return true

		else

			return false, ("Number is not an integer at position %d in Color3 type."):format(p2)

		end

	end,

	TransformEach = tonumber,

	Constructor = Color3.fromRGB

})

local function parseHexDigit(p1) --[[ parseHexDigit | Line: 21 ]]

	if #p1 == 1 then

		p1 = p1 .. p1

	end

	return tonumber(p1, 16)

end

local t = {

	Transform = function(p1) --[[ Transform | Line: 30 | Upvalues: Util (copy), parseHexDigit (copy) ]]

		local v1, v2, v3 = p1:match("^#?(%x%x?)(%x%x?)(%x%x?)$")

		return Util.Each(parseHexDigit, v1, v2, v3)

	end,

	Validate = function(p1, p2, p3) --[[ Validate | Line: 35 ]]

		return if p1 == nil or p2 == nil then false else p3 ~= nil, "Invalid hex color"

	end,

	Parse = function(...) --[[ Parse | Line: 39 ]]

		return Color3.fromRGB(...)

	end

}

return function(p1) --[[ Line: 44 | Upvalues: v1 (copy), Util (copy), t (copy) ]]

local function stringToSecondDuration(p1) --[[ stringToSecondDuration | Line: 19 | Upvalues: v1 (copy), tbl (copy) ]]

		return nil

	end

	local v12 = tonumber(p1)

		return 0, 0, true

	end

function t.significantFigures(p1, p2, p3) --[[ significantFigures | Line: 70 ]]

function t.weightedChoice(p1, p2) --[[ weightedChoice | Line: 97 | Upvalues: t (copy) ]]

	local sum = 0

	for k, v in pairs(p1) do

		if v.Weight < 0 then

			warn(p1)

			error("[Math.weightedChoice] Weight value cannot be less than zero.")

		end

		sum = sum + v.Weight

	end

	if sum <= 0 then

		warn(p1)

		error(("[Math.weightedChoice] The sum of all weights is not greater than 0 (%d)"):format(sum))

	end

	local v1 = nil

	for k, v in pairs(p1) do

		if sum_2 < v.Weight then

			return v.Value

		end

		v1 = v

	end

	return v1.Value

end

function t.GetMaxSpeedForPlayer(p1) --[[ GetMaxSpeedForPlayer | Line: 33 | Upvalues: RunService (copy), v1 (ref), Gamepasses (copy), v4 (ref), v2 (ref), v3 (ref), AdFeatures (copy) ]]

	if RunService:IsServer() then

		if v1.IsOwned(p1, Gamepasses.VEHICLE_SPEED_UNLOCKED) or v4.IsFeatureUnlocked(p1, "CarSpeed200") then

			return 200

		end

		if v1.IsOwned(p1, Gamepasses.VEHICLE_UPGRADE) or v4.IsFeatureUnlocked(p1, "CarSpeed") then

			return 100

		end

		if v1.IsOwnedLegacy(p1, Gamepasses.PREMIUM) then

			return 75

		else

			return 55

		end

	else

		if v2.IsOwned(Gamepasses.VEHICLE_SPEED_UNLOCKED) or v3.IsFeatureUnlocked(AdFeatures.VEHICLE_SPEED_MAX.id, Gamepasses.VEHICLE_SPEED_UNLOCKED) then

			return 200

		end

		if v2.IsOwned(Gamepasses.VEHICLE_UPGRADE) or v3.IsFeatureUnlocked(AdFeatures.VEHICLE_SPEED_UPGRADE.id, Gamepasses.VEHICLE_UPGRADE) then

			return 100

		end

		if v2.IsOwnedLegacy(Gamepasses.PREMIUM) then

			return 75

		else

			return 55

		end

	end

end

	end

local function barycentric(p1, p2, p3, p4) --[[ barycentric | Line: 68 ]]

	local v1 = p3 - p2

	local v2 = p4 - p2

	local v3 = p1 - p2

	local v4 = v1:Dot(v1)

	local v5 = v1:Dot(v2)

	local v6 = v2:Dot(v2)

	local v7 = v3:Dot(v1)

	local v8 = v3:Dot(v2)

	local v9 = v4 * v6 - v5 * v5

	local v10 = (v6 * v7 - v5 * v8) / v9

	local v11 = (v4 * v8 - v5 * v7) / v9

	return 1 - v10 - v11, v10, v11

end

function t.getRandomPointInSimplex(p1, p2) --[[ getRandomPointInSimplex | Line: 187 ]]

	if #p2 < 2 then

		error("Not enough points to form a simplex.")

	end

	local t = {}

	local t2 = {}

	local t3 = {}

	local sum = 0

	while #t < p1 + 1 do

		local v1 = math.random(1, #p2)

		if not t2[v1] then

			t[#t + 1] = p2[v1]

			t2[v1] = true

			local v2 = math.random()

			t3[#t3 + 1] = v2

			sum = sum + v2

		end

	end

	local sum_2 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

	for i = 1, p1 + 1 do

		sum_2 = sum_2 + t[i] * (t3[i] / sum)

	end

	return sum_2

end

function t.getNameIndexedConfig() --[[ getNameIndexedConfig | Line: 50 | Upvalues: t (copy) ]]

	while not t.isLoaded do

		task.wait()

	end

	if not t.cache then

		return

	end

	if tostring(t.cache) == t.nameIndexedCfg.cacheRef then

		return t.nameIndexedCfg.map

	end

	t.nameIndexedCfg.cacheRef = tostring(t.cache)

	t.nameIndexedCfg.map = {}

	t.nameIndexedCfg.indexLookup = {}

	for v1, v2 in t.cache do

		local t2 = {}

		local t3 = {}

		t.nameIndexedCfg.map[v1] = t2

		t.nameIndexedCfg.indexLookup[v1] = t3

		for v3, v4 in v2 do

			t3[v4.Name] = v3

			t2[v4.Name] = v4

		end

	end

	return t.nameIndexedCfg.map

end

function t.getNameToConfigIndexLookupMap() --[[ getNameToConfigIndexLookupMap | Line: 85 | Upvalues: t (copy) ]]

	while not t.isLoaded do

		task.wait()

	end

	if next(t.nameIndexedCfg.indexLookup) ~= nil then

		return t.nameIndexedCfg.indexLookup

	end

	t.getNameIndexedConfig()

	return t.nameIndexedCfg.indexLookup

function t.StartAndStopLiveOpsEventAccordingToRemoteConfig(p1) --[[ StartAndStopLiveOpsEventAccordingToRemoteConfig | Line: 65 | Upvalues: t (copy), RunService (copy), NewUserDataController (copy) ]]

	local v1 = t.GetRemoteConfigForLiveOpsEvent(p1)

	local v2 = t.GetRemoteConfigTimeWindowForLiveOpsEvent(p1)

	if not v1.InstallDateThreshold or RunService:IsServer() then

		t.StartEventWhenWindowBegins(p1, v2)

		t.StopEventWhenWindowEnds(p1, v2)

		return

	end

	local v3, _, v4 = NewUserDataController.GetNewUserData()

	if not (v3 and v4) then

		warn("Failed to get install date for LiveOps event, not starting event: " .. p1.LiveOpsEventName)

		return

	end

	if t.IsTimestampWithinInstallDateThreshold(v4, v1.InstallDateThreshold) then

		t.StartEventWhenWindowBegins(p1, v2)

		t.StopEventWhenWindowEnds(p1, v2)

	end

end

function t.IsTimestampWithinInstallDateThreshold(p1, p2) --[[ IsTimestampWithinInstallDateThreshold | Line: 91 ]]

	if p2.ThresholdType == "Before" then

		return p1 < p2.ThresholdUnixTimestamp

	else

		if p2.ThresholdType ~= "After" then

			error("Invalid threshold type for install date threshold: " .. p2.ThresholdType)

		end

	end

end

function t.Descendants(p1) --[[ Descendants | Line: 41 ]]

function t2.Join(p1) --[[ Join | Line: 46 ]]

	local t = {}

	local t2 = {}

	for v1, v2 in p1 do

		local v3 = v2.Name

		if v3 == nil or v3 == "" then

			error("Item exists with no name")

		end

		if t[v3] then

			warn((("Skipping additional duplicate item: %*"):format(v3)))

			continue

		end

		local v4 = t2[v3]

		if v4 == nil then

			t2[v3] = v2

			continue

		end

		if v2.Join and v4.Join then

			local v6 = false

			for v7, v8 in v2 do

				if v7 ~= "Name" and v7 ~= "Join" and v4[v7] == nil then

					v4[v7] = v8

				elseif v7 ~= "Name" and v7 ~= "Join" then

					warn((("Keys may not be duplicated: Key %* for item %*."):format(v7, v3)))

					v6 = true

					break

				end

			end

			if v6 then

				t2[v3] = nil

				t[v3] = true

			end

			continue

		end

		warn((("Duplicate items specified: %*. Set \"Join\" to true if this is intentional and you want to merge their values"):format(v3)))

		t2[v3] = nil

		t[v3] = true

	end

	local t3 = {}

	for v9, v10 in t2 do

		v10.Join = nil

		table.insert(t3, v10)

	end

	return t3

end

function t.ApplyToModel(p1, p2) --[[ ApplyToModel | Line: 78 | Upvalues: t (copy) ]]

	if not t.IsValid(p2) then

		return false, "Invalid texture"

	end

	local v1 = t.GetTemplate(p2)

	if v1 == nil then

		return false, "Texture template not found"

	end

	if Touch == nil then

		return false, "Touch part not found"

	end

	local v2 = p1:GetAttribute("CurrentColor")

	for v3, v4 in Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems() do

		local v5 = "CustomTexture_" .. v4.Name

		local v6 = Touch:FindFirstChild(v5)

			v6:Destroy()

local function getFeatured(p1, p2, p3) --[[ getFeatured | Line: 23 ]]

	local v1 = math.max(#p1, #p2)

	local v4 = p3 - (if p3 < v1 then 1 else 0)

	local t = {}

	for i = 1, v4 do

		if #p2 < i then

			break

		end

		table.insert(t, p2[i])

	end

	local count = 1

	while #t < v4 and count <= #p1 do

		if not table.find(t, p1[count]) then

			table.insert(t, p1[count])

		end

		count = count + 1

	end

	return t, math.max(v1 - v4, 0)

end

function v1.CheckIfShouldShowUpsell(p1, p2, p3) --[[ CheckIfShouldShowUpsell | Line: 18 | Upvalues: NoMotorVehicleSpeedUtil (copy), LocalPlayer (copy) ]]

	local v1 = NoMotorVehicleSpeedUtil.GetMaxSpeedForPlayer(LocalPlayer)

	if not v1 then

		warn("Max speed not found")

		return

	end

	if v1 == NoMotorVehicleSpeedUtil.VEHICLE_SPEED_UNLOCKED_MAX_SPEED then

		p3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

		p3:SetAttribute("ShouldShowUpsell", false)

		return

	end

	if v1 <= p2 then

		p3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(133, 255, 80)

		p3:SetAttribute("ShouldShowUpsell", true)

	else

		p3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

		p3:SetAttribute("ShouldShowUpsell", false)

	end

end

function v1.LoadNextBatch(p1) --[[ LoadNextBatch | Line: 93 | Upvalues: UnlockableController (copy), Gamepasses (copy), GamepassController (copy), WearingController (copy) ]]

		warn("PlayAnimationOnContact:Start() - Animation not found:", p1.Instance)

		return

	end

	local Character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character

	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

		return

	end

			p1:Leave()

		end))

			p1:Leave()

		end)

	end

local function getModelBaseY(p1) --[[ getModelBaseY | Line: 142 ]]

	local v1, v2 = p1:GetBoundingBox()

	local v4 = v2.Y / 2

	end

	return v6

end

function v1.PreviewScale(p1, p2, p3) --[[ PreviewScale | Line: 159 | Upvalues: GameUtil (copy), t (copy), getModelBaseY (copy) ]]

		return false, "Resizing is only available on private servers"

	end

	if not (t.number(p2) and t.number(p3)) then

		return

	end

	local v1 = p1.Instance

	if not v1.PrimaryPart then

		return

	end

	v1:ScaleTo(p2)

	local v2 = p3 - getModelBaseY(v1)

	if v2 == 0 then

		p1:syncBillboardPreviewAnchor()

		return

	end

	v1:PivotTo(v1:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, v2, 0))

	p1:syncBillboardPreviewAnchor()

end

function v2._GetVerticalScalar(p1) --[[ _GetVerticalScalar | Line: 176 | Upvalues: PreferredInput (copy) ]]

		local v1 = p1._keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) or p1._upButtonDown

	elseif PreferredInput.Current == "Gamepad" then

		local v5 = p1._gamepad:IsButtonDown(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1) or p1._upButtonDown

	else

		end

	end

end

function v1.AnimationSpeed(p1) --[[ AnimationSpeed | Line: 28 ]]

	while true do

		p1.verticalVelocity = p1.model.Velocity.Y

		task.wait()

		if p1.isJumping or p1.isFalling then

			p1.adjustPosition = false

		else

			local v1 = p1.model.Velocity.magnitude / 25

			local Magnitude = Vector3.new(p1.model.Velocity.X, 0, p1.model.Velocity.Z).Magnitude

			p1.fallingAnimation:Stop()

			if v1 > 0.4 then

				if not p1.walkAnimation.IsPlaying then

					p1.walkAnimation:Play(nil, nil, 1)

					if p1.adjustPosition then

						p1.walkAnimation.TimePosition = (p1.idleAnimation.TimePosition / p1.idleAnimation.Length + 0.05) % 1 * p1.walkAnimation.Length

						if Magnitude < 0.1 then

							p1.walkAnimation.TimePosition = 0

						end

					end

					p1.adjustPosition = true

				end

				p1.walkAnimation:AdjustSpeed(v1)

				p1.idleAnimation:Stop(0.1)

			else

				if not p1.idleAnimation.IsPlaying then

					p1.idleAnimation:Play(nil, nil, 1)

					if p1.adjustPosition then

						p1.idleAnimation.TimePosition = (p1.walkAnimation.TimePosition / p1.walkAnimation.Length + 0.05) % 1 * p1.idleAnimation.Length

						if Magnitude < 0.1 then

							p1.idleAnimation.TimePosition = 0

						end

					end

					p1.adjustPosition = true

				end

				p1.walkAnimation:Stop(0.1)

			end

		end

	end

local function profilingLoop() --[[ profilingLoop | Line: 113 | Upvalues: RunService (copy), t2 (copy), Stats (copy), t (copy) ]]

		for v1, v2 in t2 do

			end

			end

			avgCPURenderTime.sum = avgCPURenderTime.sum + Stats.RenderCPUFrameTime

			avgCPURenderTime.amount = avgCPURenderTime.amount + 1

			avgTotalMemory.amount = avgTotalMemory.amount + 1

function t.WaitForPanel(p1, p2) --[[ WaitForPanel | Line: 204 | Upvalues: t (copy), t2 (copy), CountDownLatch (copy), v1 (copy), warno (copy) ]]

		t.LoadLazy(p1, p2, true)

	end

	if t2[p1] == nil then

		t2[p1] = {

			latch = CountDownLatch.new(1),

			panels = {}

		}

	end

		warno("Panel context not loaded after " .. v1 .. " secs", p1, p2)

		return nil

			panel = nil,

			latch = CountDownLatch.new(1)

		}

	end

	if t2[p1].panels[p2].latch:await(v1) then

		t2[p1].panels[p2].latch:await()

		return t2[p1].panels[p2].panel

	else

		warno("Panel not loaded after " .. v1 .. " secs", p1, p2)

		return nil

	end

end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local Component = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Component)

local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Janitor)

local ComponentUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Shared.Utils.ComponentUtil)

local LoadableEntries = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Client.Components.UI.Utils.Loadables.LoadableEntries)

local PanelController = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Client.UI.PanelController)

local ClearTools = require(StarterGui.Player8Handler.Game8Settings).ClearTools

local v1 = Component.new({

	Tag = "GunWeaponMenu"

})

function v1.Construct(p1) --[[ Construct | Line: 24 | Upvalues: Janitor (copy) ]]

	p1._Janitor = Janitor.new()

	p1._gunSniperEntriesJanitor = p1._Janitor:Add(Janitor.new())

	p1._dbGunClose = false

	p1._dbClickWeapon = false

end

function v1.Start(p1) --[[ Start | Line: 33 | Upvalues: ComponentUtil (copy), LoadableEntries (copy), PanelController (copy) ]]

	for v1, v2 in p1.Instance.Catalog.Header.CategoryTabs:GetChildren() do

		if v2:IsA("TextButton") or v2:IsA("ImageButton") then

			v2.SelectionOrder = 2000

		end

	end

	local v3 = ComponentUtil.GetComponentFromInstance(p1.Instance.Catalog.Container.ScrollingFrame, LoadableEntries)

	p1._Janitor:Add(v3.Loaded:Connect(function() --[[ Line: 42 | Upvalues: p1 (copy) ]]

		for v1, v2 in p1.Instance.Catalog.Container.ScrollingFrame:GetChildren() do

			p1:SetupGunSniperButton(v2)

		end

	end))

	if v3:IsLoaded() then

		for v4, v5 in p1.Instance.Catalog.Container.ScrollingFrame:GetChildren() do

			v5:SetAttribute("AttachedConnection", nil)

			p1:SetupGunSniperButton(v5)

		end

	end

	p1._Janitor:Add(v3.Added:Connect(function(p12) --[[ Line: 55 | Upvalues: p1 (copy) ]]

		for v1, v2 in p12 do

			p1:SetupGunSniperButton(v2)

		end

	end))

	p1._Janitor:Add(v3.Unloaded:Connect(function() --[[ Line: 61 | Upvalues: p1 (copy) ]]

		p1._gunSniperEntriesJanitor:Cleanup()

		for v1, v2 in p1.Instance.Catalog.Container.ScrollingFrame:GetChildren() do

			v2:SetAttribute("AttachedConnection", nil)

		end

	end))

	p1._Janitor:Add(p1.Instance.Catalog.Header.CategoryTabs.Close.MouseButton1Click:connect(function() --[[ Line: 68 | Upvalues: p1 (copy), PanelController (ref) ]]

		if p1._dbGunClose ~= false then

			return

		end

		p1._dbGunClose = true

		PanelController.Close("NoResetGUIHandler", "GunWeaponMenu")

		wait(0.5)

		p1._dbGunClose = false

	end))

end

function v1.ClearCheckMarksGunSniper(p1) --[[ ClearCheckMarksGunSniper | Line: 78 ]]

	for k, v in pairs(p1.Instance.Catalog.Container.ScrollingFrame:GetChildren()) do

		if v:isA("ImageButton") then

			v:RemoveTag("Checked")

		end

	end

end

function v1.SetupGunSniperButton(p1, p2) --[[ SetupGunSniperButton | Line: 86 | Upvalues: ClearTools (copy), PanelController (copy) ]]

	if not p2:IsA("ImageButton") then

		return

	end

	if p2:GetAttribute("AttachedConnection") ~= nil then

		return

	end

	p2:SetAttribute("AttachedConnection", true)

	p1._gunSniperEntriesJanitor:Add(p2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() --[[ Line: 93 | Upvalues: p2 (copy), p1 (copy), ClearTools (ref), PanelController (ref) ]]

		local v1 = p2.Name

		if p1._dbClickWeapon ~= false or p2 == nil then

			return

		end

		p1._dbClickWeapon = true

		p1:ClearCheckMarksGunSniper()

		if p2.Name == "Skins" then

			if p2.Name == "Skins" then

				PanelController.Close("NoResetGUIHandler", "GunWeaponMenu")

				PanelController.Open("NoResetGUIHandler", "GunSkinsMenu")

			end

		else

			ClearTools:FireServer("RequestingAccessory", v1)

			if p2.Name ~= "Silencer" and p2.Name ~= "Flashlight" then

				p2:AddTag("Checked")

			end

		end

		wait(0.7)

		p1._dbClickWeapon = false

	end))

end

function v1.Stop(p1) --[[ Stop | Line: 117 ]]

	p1._Janitor:Destroy()

end

return v1

local function SlerpVector3(p1, p2, p3) --[[ SlerpVector3 | Line: 284 ]]

	if p3 <= 0 then

		return p1

	end

	if p3 >= 1 then

		return p2

	end

	local Unit = p1.Unit

	local Unit_2 = p2.Unit

	local v3 = math.acos((math.clamp(Unit:Dot(Unit_2), -1, 1)))

	if v3 < 0.00001 then

		return p1:Lerp(p2, p3)

	else

		local v4 = math.sin(v3)

		return (Unit * (math.sin((1 - p3) * v3) / v4) + Unit_2 * (math.sin(p3 * v3) / v4)) * (p1.Magnitude * (1 - p3) + p2.Magnitude * p3)

	end

end

local function CastVectorToLocalFlatPlanarSurface(p1, p2) --[[ CastVectorToLocalFlatPlanarSurface | Line: 309 ]]

	if p2.Magnitude < 0.001 then

		return CFrame.identity

	else

		local Unit_2 = Unit:Cross(p2.Unit).Unit

	end

end

local function otherConnectedPart(p1, p2) --[[ otherConnectedPart | Line: 25 ]]

	if p1.Part1 == p2 and (p1.Part0 ~= nil and p1.Part0:IsA("BasePart")) then

		return p1.Part0

	end

	if p1.Part0 == p2 and (p1.Part1 ~= nil and p1.Part1:IsA("BasePart")) then

		return p1.Part1

	else

		return nil

	end

end

local function findLegacyWeldOnHandle(p1) --[[ findLegacyWeldOnHandle | Line: 37 ]]

	local AccessoryWeld = p1:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")

	if AccessoryWeld ~= nil and AccessoryWeld:IsA("Weld") then

		return AccessoryWeld

	end

	for v1, v2 in p1:GetChildren() do

		if v2:IsA("Weld") then

			return v2

		end

	end

	for v3, v4 in p1:GetDescendants() do

		if v4:IsA("Weld") then

			return v4

		end

	end

function t.RequestNoMotorVehicle(p1, p2) --[[ RequestNoMotorVehicle | Line: 103 | Upvalues: Client2Client (copy), Players (copy), LocalPlayer (copy), ItemRegistry (copy), VehicleMiddleware (copy), NotificationController (copy), NoMotorVehicles (copy), NoMotorAnimationController (copy), MainAudio (copy), PanelController (copy), ContextActionService (copy), NoMotorVehicleRequest (copy), Game8Settings (copy) ]]

		return false

		return false

		return false

		return false

			NoMotorAnimationController.StartSpeedControl("UnicycleAnimation")

		elseif NoMotor == "GirlBikeAnimation" then

			NoMotorAnimationController.StartSpeedControl("GirlBikeAnimation")

		elseif NoMotor == "SegwaySmallAnimation" then

			NoMotorAnimationController.Play("SegwaySmallAnimation")

function t.new(p1, p2, p3, p4) --[[ new | Line: 28 | Upvalues: v1 (copy), t (copy) ]]

	if p3 == nil then

		p3 = 0

	end

	if p4 == nil then

		p4 = 0

	end

	assert(if type(p1) == "number" then true else false, "Magnitude must be a number")

	assert(if type(p2) == "number" then true else false, "Roughness must be a number")

	assert(if type(p3) == "number" then true else false, "FadeInTime must be a number")

	assert(if type(p4) == "number" then true else false, "FadeOutTime must be a number")

	local t2 = {

		DeleteOnInactive = true,

		roughMod = 1,

		magnMod = 1,

		_camShakeInstance = true,

		Magnitude = p1,

		Roughness = p2,

		PositionInfluence = v1(),

		RotationInfluence = v1(),

		fadeOutDuration = p4,

		fadeInDuration = p3

	}

	t2.sustain = p3 > 0

	t2.currentFadeTime = if p3 > 0 then 0 else 1

	t2.tick = Random.new():NextNumber(-100, 100)

function t.UpdateShake(p1, p2) --[[ UpdateShake | Line: 59 | Upvalues: noise (copy), v1 (copy) ]]

	local v12 = p1.tick

	local currentFadeTime = p1.currentFadeTime

	local v2 = v1(noise(v12, 0) * 0.5, noise(0, v12) * 0.5, noise(v12, v12) * 0.5)

	if p1.fadeInDuration > 0 and p1.sustain then

		if currentFadeTime < 1 then

			currentFadeTime = currentFadeTime + p2 / p1.fadeInDuration

		elseif p1.fadeOutDuration > 0 then

			p1.sustain = false

		end

	end

	if not p1.sustain then

		currentFadeTime = currentFadeTime - p2 / p1.fadeOutDuration

	end

	if p1.sustain then

		p1.tick = v12 + p2 * p1.Roughness * p1.roughMod

	else

		p1.tick = v12 + p2 * p1.Roughness * p1.roughMod * currentFadeTime

	end

	p1.currentFadeTime = currentFadeTime

	return v2 * p1.Magnitude * p1.magnMod * currentFadeTime

end

	p1.fadeOutDuration = 0

	p1.sustain = true

end

function t.IsFadingOut(p1) --[[ IsFadingOut | Line: 145 ]]

function t.IsFadingIn(p1) --[[ IsFadingIn | Line: 150 ]]

function t.GetState(p1) --[[ GetState | Line: 155 | Upvalues: t (copy) ]]

	if p1:IsFadingIn() then

		return t.CameraShakeState.FadingIn

	end

	if p1:IsFadingOut() then

		return t.CameraShakeState.FadingOut

	end

	if p1:IsShaking() then

		return t.CameraShakeState.Sustained

	else

		return t.CameraShakeState.Inactive

	end

end

return function(p1, p2, p3) --[[ springCoefficients | Line: 22 ]]

		return 1, 0, 0, 1

	end

	if p2 > 1 then

		local v1 = math.sqrt(p2 ^ 2 - 1)

		local v2 = -0.5 / (v1 * p3)

		local v3 = p3 * (v1 + p2) * -1

		local v4 = p3 * (v1 - p2)

		local v5 = math.exp(p1 * v3)

		local v6 = math.exp(p1 * v4)

		return (v6 * v3 - v5 * v4) * v2, (v5 - v6) * v2 / p3, (v6 - v5) * v2 * p3, (v5 * v3 - v6 * v4) * v2

		local v8 = v7 * -1

	else

		local v11 = 1 / v10

		local v12 = math.exp(p1 * -1 * p3 * p2)

		local v13 = v12 * math.sin(v10 * p1)

	end

function t.step(p1, p2) --[[ step | Line: 46 ]]

	local fRising = p1.fRising

	local g = p1.g

	local v = p1.v

	local v3 = 6.283185307179586 * (if v > 0 and fRising then fRising else p1.fFalling)

	local v4 = p1.p - g

	local v5 = math.exp(-v3 * p2)

	local v6 = (v4 * (1 + v3 * p2) + v * p2) * v5 + g

	p1.p = v6

	p1.v = (v * (1 - v3 * p2) - v4 * (v3 * v3 * p2)) * v5

	return v6

end

		ZombieONOFF.Value = true

		DisasterRunningZombie.Value = false

function t.Zombie(p1, p2) --[[ Zombie | Line: 88 | Upvalues: DisasterRunningZombie (copy), ZombieONOFF (copy), Owner (copy), Flying (copy), HouseModel (copy), PointToSet (copy) ]]

	if DisasterRunningZombie.Value == false and (ZombieONOFF.Value == false and (Owner.Value == p2.Name and script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie") == nil)) then

		DisasterRunningZombie.Value = true

		ZombieONOFF.Value = true

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Loading")

		wait(2)

		local HouseZombie = game.ServerStorage.HouseDisasters.HouseZombie["Zombie" .. HouseModel.Value]:Clone()

		HouseZombie.Name = "HouseZombie"

		HouseZombie.Parent = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

		HouseZombie:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(PointToSet.position) * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * (PointToSet.CFrame - PointToSet.Position))

		wait(2)

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Loaded")

		DisasterRunningZombie.Value = false

		return

	end

	if DisasterRunningZombie.Value ~= false or ZombieONOFF.Value ~= true then

		return

	end

	DisasterRunningZombie.Value = true

	Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Removing Zombie")

	wait(2)

	if script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie") ~= nil then

		script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie"):Destroy()

	end

	wait(2)

	Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Deleted")

	ZombieONOFF.Value = false

	DisasterRunningZombie.Value = false

end

function t.Fire(p1, p2) --[[ Fire | Line: 165 | Upvalues: DisasterRunningFire (copy), FireONOFF (copy), Owner (copy), Flying (copy), HouseModel (copy), Game8Settings (copy), PointToSet (copy) ]]

	if DisasterRunningFire.Value == false and (FireONOFF.Value == false and Owner.Value == p2.Name) then

		DisasterRunningFire.Value = true

		FireONOFF.Value = true

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Fire Loading")

		wait(2)

		local HouseFire

		if script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseFire") == nil then

			HouseFire = game.ServerStorage.HouseFires[HouseModel.Value]:Clone()

			HouseFire.Name = "HouseFire"

			game.Debris:AddItem(HouseFire, Game8Settings.HouseFireTimeStayInModel)

			HouseFire.Parent = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

			Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Fire Loaded")

			DisasterRunningFire.Value = false

			return

		end

		script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseFire"):Destroy()

		HouseFire = game.ServerStorage.HouseFires[HouseModel.Value]:Clone()

		HouseFire.Name = "HouseFire"

		game.Debris:AddItem(HouseFire, Game8Settings.HouseFireTimeStayInModel)

		HouseFire.Parent = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

		HouseFire:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(PointToSet.position) * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * (PointToSet.CFrame - PointToSet.Position))

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Fire Loaded")

	else

		if DisasterRunningFire.Value ~= false or FireONOFF.Value ~= true then

			return

		end

		DisasterRunningFire.Value = true

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Removing Fire")

		wait(2)

		if script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseFire") ~= nil then

		end

		wait(2)

		FireONOFF.Value = false

end

function SwitchLightsOff() --[[ SwitchLightsOff | Line: 43 | Upvalues: v1 (copy) ]]

	for k, v in pairs((v1["001_HouseLights"]:GetDescendants())) do

		if (v.className == "PointLight" or (v.className == "SpotLight" or v.className == "SurfaceLight")) and v.Enabled == true then

			v.Enabled = false

		end

	end

end

function SwitchLightsNeonOff() --[[ SwitchLightsNeonOff | Line: 54 | Upvalues: v1 (copy) ]]

	for k, v in pairs((v1["001_HouseLights"]:GetDescendants())) do

		if (v.className == "Part" and v.Name == "Neon" or v.className == "MeshPart" and v.Name == "Neon") and v.Transparency == 0 then

			v.Transparency = 0.8

		end

	end

end

	for k, v in pairs((v1["001_HouseLights"]:GetDescendants())) do

function t.Zombie(p1, p2) --[[ Zombie | Line: 88 | Upvalues: DisasterRunningZombie (copy), ZombieONOFF (copy), Owner (copy), Flying (copy), HouseModel (copy), PointToSet (copy) ]]

	if DisasterRunningZombie.Value == false and (ZombieONOFF.Value == false and (Owner.Value == p2.Name and script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie") == nil)) then

		DisasterRunningZombie.Value = true

		ZombieONOFF.Value = true

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Loading")

		wait(2)

		local HouseZombie = game.ServerStorage.HouseDisasters.HouseZombie["Zombie" .. HouseModel.Value]:Clone()

		HouseZombie.Name = "HouseZombie"

		HouseZombie.Parent = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

		HouseZombie:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(PointToSet.position) * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * (PointToSet.CFrame - PointToSet.Position))

		wait(2)

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Loaded")

		DisasterRunningZombie.Value = false

		return

	end

	if DisasterRunningZombie.Value ~= false or ZombieONOFF.Value ~= true then

		return

	end

	DisasterRunningZombie.Value = true

	Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Removing Zombie")

	wait(2)

	if script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie") ~= nil then

		script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie"):Destroy()

	end

	wait(2)

	Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Deleted")

	ZombieONOFF.Value = false

	DisasterRunningZombie.Value = false

end

function t.Fire(p1, p2) --[[ Fire | Line: 165 | Upvalues: DisasterRunningFire (copy), FireONOFF (copy), Owner (copy), Flying (copy), HouseModel (copy), Game8Settings (copy), PointToSet (copy) ]]

	if DisasterRunningFire.Value == false and (FireONOFF.Value == false and Owner.Value == p2.Name) then

		DisasterRunningFire.Value = true

		local HouseFire

			HouseFire = game.ServerStorage.HouseFires[HouseModel.Value]:Clone()

			HouseFire.Parent = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

		end

		script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseFire"):Destroy()

		HouseFire = game.ServerStorage.HouseFires[HouseModel.Value]:Clone()

		HouseFire.Name = "HouseFire"

		game.Debris:AddItem(HouseFire, Game8Settings.HouseFireTimeStayInModel)

		HouseFire.Parent = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

		HouseFire:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(PointToSet.position) * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * (PointToSet.CFrame - PointToSet.Position))

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Fire Loaded")

	else

		if DisasterRunningFire.Value ~= false or FireONOFF.Value ~= true then

			return

		end

		DisasterRunningFire.Value = true

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Removing Fire")

function t.Zombie(p1, p2) --[[ Zombie | Line: 88 | Upvalues: DisasterRunningZombie (copy), ZombieONOFF (copy), Owner (copy), Flying (copy), HouseModel (copy), PointToSet (copy) ]]

	if DisasterRunningZombie.Value == false and (ZombieONOFF.Value == false and (Owner.Value == p2.Name and script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie") == nil)) then

		DisasterRunningZombie.Value = true

		ZombieONOFF.Value = true

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Loading")

		wait(2)

		local HouseZombie = game.ServerStorage.HouseDisasters.HouseZombie["Zombie" .. HouseModel.Value]:Clone()

		HouseZombie.Name = "HouseZombie"

		HouseZombie.Parent = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

		HouseZombie:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(PointToSet.position) * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * (PointToSet.CFrame - PointToSet.Position))

		wait(2)

		Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Loaded")

		DisasterRunningZombie.Value = false

		return

	end

	if DisasterRunningZombie.Value ~= false or ZombieONOFF.Value ~= true then

		return

	end

	DisasterRunningZombie.Value = true

	Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Removing Zombie")

	wait(2)

	if script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie") ~= nil then

		script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("HouseZombie"):Destroy()

	end

	wait(2)

	Flying:FireClient(p2, "DisasterControlMessage", "Zombie Deleted")

	ZombieONOFF.Value = false

	DisasterRunningZombie.Value = false

end

function t.getLooseBoundingSphere(p1) --[[ getLooseBoundingSphere | Line: 67 ]]
